### English
- Stabilize page element hiding across dynamic sibling updates and CSS Modules hash changes, avoiding accidental hiding of unrelated elements. - Replace "Dock Starting Position" in General Settings with "Show Web Apps in System Dock" and "Show Floating Dock" toggles. Turning off the floating Dock pauses 80% occlusion auto-collapse while keeping `×` / `⌘W` session preservation. - Use gentle update reminders instead of silent automatic installation.
### 简体中文
- 加固网页元素隐藏选择器的稳定性，在动态增减节点与 CSS Modules 哈希变化后仍能准确命中目标元素，避免误藏其他内容。 - 移除通用设置中的「Dock 初始位置」，新增「在系统 Dock 显示网页应用」与「显示悬浮 Dock」两个开关；关闭悬浮 Dock 时停止遮挡 80% 自动收起，同时保留 `×` / `⌘W` 隐藏并维持会话。 - 改为温和的更新提醒交互，不再在后台静默自动覆盖安装。

### English
- Smooth the launcher transition when it attaches to the edge of the screen. - Fix Reload and Reload Without Cache after a page's first load fails before WebKit assigns a current URL. Retrying opens the intended page again.
### 简体中文
- 让启动器贴到屏幕边缘时的过渡更平滑。 - 修复网页首次加载失败、WebKit 尚未记录当前地址时「重新加载」和「不使用缓存重新加载」无效的问题。重试会再次打开原页面。

## English
- Each web app window now shows the app's name centered in the top chrome band, with the same borderless treatment as the surrounding icons. The title hides instead of truncating when the window is too narrow to fit it.
## 简体中文
- 每个网页应用窗口顶部正中间显示该应用的名字，和两侧图标一样不画底板、不加描边；窗口窄到放不下时直接隐藏，不截断。

## English
- Bookmark rows now have a native right-click menu with Open, Rename, Add WebApp and Delete. Rename edits only the title; blank names are rejected. - Add WebApp creates an isolated web app from the bookmark's title and saved URL without reopening the management window. Source HTTP cookies, including HttpOnly and session cookies, are copied through a one-time Keychain handoff and imported by the destination runtime before its first navigation; the two apps stay isolated afterwards. - Website icons now recover without restarting the host. Transient load failures retry with capped backoff, and memory pressure only pauses speculative prefetching without blocking requested icons.
## 简体中文
- 收藏夹每行新增原生右键菜单：打开、重命名、添加为网页应用、删除。重命名只改标题，不接受空白名称。 - 从收藏直接添加网页应用时，沿用该收藏的标题与完整链接，无需再打开管理窗口手动填写。来源的 HTTP Cookie（含 HttpOnly 与会话 Cookie）经一次性钥匙串交接，由目标运行时在首次导航前导入；新旧应用之后保持隔离。 - 网站图标加载失败后无需重启即可恢复：短暂失败按上限退避重试，内存压力只暂停推测性预取，不阻塞用户请求的图标。

NeatWebApp macOS 0.3.34
- 把常用网站装成独立的 macOS 应用，从刘海位置的启动器一键唤出。 - 支持应用内自动检查、下载并安装更新。 - 安装包经过 Developer ID 签名与苹果公证，更新包另有 EdDSA 签名。 - 下载版双击即可打开，不需要执行任何解除限制命令。

## English
- Switch directly to each running web app with Command-Tab or the system Dock, including windows collapsed into the activity Dock. - Each web app uses its website icon in a consistent Apple-style rounded rectangle. The host and warm standby helpers stay out of the Dock and app switcher. - Switching back restores the existing page and session without opening settings. The notch launcher, activity Dock and automatic window collapse remain available. - Open the management window directly from the notch launcher's Add button.
## 简体中文
- 支持通过 Command-Tab 或系统程序坞直接切换到每个正在运行的网页应用，已收进悬浮 Dock 的窗口也能恢复。 - 每个网页应用使用自己网站的图标，统一呈现苹果风格的圆角矩形；主程序和预热进程不占系统 Dock 或应用切换列表。 - 切回时恢复原有网页和会话，不会弹出设置；顶部刘海、悬浮 Dock 和窗口自动收起保持可用。 - 支持从顶部刘海的加号直接打开管理窗口。

## Changes
- Restore the compact download status beside the browser’s More Actions menu. - View filenames, live progress, transferred sizes and completion or failure in a small download list. - Reveal individual files in Finder and clear finished records without removing files or hiding active transfers.
## 更新内容
- 恢复浏览器右上角更多菜单旁的紧凑下载状态。 - 通过小型下载列表查看文件名、实时进度、已下载大小及完成或失败状态。 - 可在访达中定位单个文件，并清除已结束的记录；不会删除文件，也不会隐藏正在下载的任务。

NeatWebApp macOS 0.3.30
- The activity Dock now appears where each web app window collapses: its top-leading corner lands on the collapsed window's top-leading corner (where the × button was), kept inside the screen. Dragging still works until the next collapse. - The Dock's clear Liquid Glass stays visible over solid-color backgrounds: the native glass shadow is no longer clipped, and a thin rim that adapts to light and dark appearance outlines the capsule.
---
- 活动 Dock 现在会出现在每次网页应用窗口收起的位置：Dock 左上角对准收起窗口的左上角（原 × 按钮处），并保持在屏幕内。仍可手动拖动，直到下一次收起。 - 纯色背景上也能看清 Dock 的通透液态玻璃：系统自带的玻璃阴影不再被裁掉，并加了一圈随浅色/深色外观变化的细边勾出轮廓。

NeatWebApp macOS 0.3.29
- 修复两个置顶窗口交叠时鼠标放重叠区疯狂切换焦点的闪烁：后窗在被遮挡的点位不再参与抢焦点。 - 悬停抢焦点加入通用防抖：指针持续停留 150 毫秒才接管，窗口焦点变化后 350 毫秒内不再抢，边沿附近不再抖两三次。

NeatWebApp macOS 0.3.28
- 把常用网站装成独立的 macOS 应用，从刘海位置的启动器一键唤出。 - 支持应用内自动检查、下载并安装更新。 - 安装包经过 Developer ID 签名与苹果公证，更新包另有 EdDSA 签名。 - 下载版双击即可打开，不需要执行任何解除限制命令。
